verification_commands.command:
$componentAuditInput = @'
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import pathlib
import re

BASE = pathlib.Path("/root/aidoku-phase3")
B7 = BASE / "evidence/candidate7/build"
B8 = BASE / "evidence/candidate8/build"

def load_json(path):
    return json.loads(path.read_bytes().decode("utf-8-sig"))

def sha_file(path):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            h.update(chunk)
    return h.hexdigest()

def file_binding(path):
    return {"path": str(path), "bytes": path.stat().st_size, "sha256": sha_file(path)}

def canonical_sha(records):
    content = json.dumps(records, ensure_ascii=True, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False).encode("utf-8")
    return hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest()

def check_manifest(path, root):
    manifest = load_json(path)
    expected = {r["path"]: r for r in manifest["files"]}
    seen_paths = set()
    for name in manifest["included_files"]:
        p = root / name
        if p.is_file():
            seen_paths.add(name)
    for name in manifest["included_directories"]:
        directory = root / name
        if directory.is_dir():
            for p in directory.rglob("*"):
                if p.is_file():
                    seen_paths.add(p.relative_to(root).as_posix())
    computed = []
    mismatches = []
    for relative in sorted(expected):
        p = root / relative
        if not p.is_file():
            mismatches.append({"path": relative, "problem": "missing"})
            continue
        item = {"path": relative, "bytes": p.stat().st_size, "sha256": sha_file(p)}
        computed.append(item)
        if item != expected[relative]:
            mismatches.append({"path": relative, "expected": expected[relative], "actual": item})
    return {
        "manifest": file_binding(path), "root": str(root),
        "claimed_count": manifest["file_count"], "record_count": len(manifest["files"]),
        "unique_path_count": len(expected),
        "record_paths_sorted_unique": list(expected) == sorted(set(expected)),
        "manifest_source_sha256": manifest["sha256"],
        "recomputed_record_sha256": canonical_sha(manifest["files"]),
        "recomputed_tree_sha256": canonical_sha(computed),
        "discovered_path_count": len(seen_paths),
        "missing_discovered_paths": sorted(set(expected) - seen_paths),
        "extra_discovered_paths": sorted(seen_paths - set(expected)),
        "mismatches": mismatches,
        "matches": len(computed) == manifest["file_count"] and not mismatches and seen_paths == set(expected) and canonical_sha(computed) == manifest["sha256"]
    }

m7path = B7 / "source-after-gate-01.json"
m8path = B8 / "source-after-gate-01.json"
m7 = load_json(m7path)
m8 = load_json(m8path)
r7 = {r["path"]: r for r in m7["files"]}
r8 = {r["path"]: r for r in m8["files"]}
modified = [{"path": p, "before": r7[p], "after": r8[p]} for p in sorted(set(r7) & set(r8)) if r7[p] != r8[p]]
source = {
    "candidate7_snapshot": check_manifest(m7path, BASE / "candidate7/source-snapshot"),
    "candidate8_snapshot": check_manifest(m8path, BASE / "candidate8/source-snapshot"),
    "candidate8_master": check_manifest(m8path, BASE / "source"),
    "modified": modified, "added": sorted(set(r8) - set(r7)), "removed": sorted(set(r7) - set(r8)),
    "unchanged_records": sum(r7[p] == r8[p] for p in set(r7) & set(r8)),
    "included_scope_equal": m7["included_files"] == m8["included_files"] and m7["included_directories"] == m8["included_directories"],
}

binary7 = BASE / "candidate7/desktop/aidoku"
binary8 = BASE / "candidate8/desktop/aidoku"
h7 = hashlib.sha256()
h8 = hashlib.sha256()
equal = True
count7 = 0
count8 = 0
with binary7.open("rb") as a, binary8.open("rb") as b:
    while True:
        x = a.read(1024 * 1024)
        y = b.read(1024 * 1024)
        if not x and not y:
            break
        h7.update(x)
        h8.update(y)
        count7 += len(x)
        count8 += len(y)
        equal = equal and x == y
binary = {
    "candidate7": {"path": str(binary7), "bytes": count7, "stat_bytes": binary7.stat().st_size, "sha256": h7.hexdigest()},
    "candidate8": {"path": str(binary8), "bytes": count8, "stat_bytes": binary8.stat().st_size, "sha256": h8.hexdigest()},
    "equal": equal and count7 == count8, "bytes_compared": min(count7, count8),
    "method": "Independent single-pass streaming comparison and two individual SHA-256 calculations in 1 MiB chunks."
}

treepath = B8 / "default-active-tree.txt"
tree = treepath.read_text()
tree_backend_lines = [line for line in tree.splitlines() if re.search(r"(?<![A-Za-z0-9_-])slint-backend-kindle(?=[\s@]|$)", line)]
metapath = B8 / "default-metadata.json"
meta = load_json(metapath)
packages = {p["id"]: p for p in meta["packages"]}
nodes = {n["id"]: n for n in meta["resolve"]["nodes"]}
root = meta["resolve"]["root"]
reachable = set()
todo = [root]
while todo:
    pid = todo.pop()
    if pid in reachable:
        continue
    reachable.add(pid)
    todo.extend(nodes.get(pid, {}).get("dependencies", []))
backend_ids = {pid for pid, p in packages.items() if p["name"] == "slint-backend-kindle"}
jsonlpath = B8 / "desktop-artifacts-01.jsonl"
messages = [json.loads(line) for line in jsonlpath.read_text().splitlines() if line.strip()]
artifacts = [m for m in messages if m.get("reason") == "compiler-artifact"]
artifact_backend = [m["package_id"] for m in artifacts if m["package_id"] in backend_ids or re.search(r"(?:#|[/ ])slint-backend-kindle(?:@| |$)", m["package_id"])]
selectedpath = B8 / "desktop-selected-artifact.json"
selected = load_json(selectedpath)
selected_matches = [m for m in artifacts if m == selected]
root_artifacts = [m for m in artifacts if m["package_id"] == root and m.get("target", {}).get("name") == "aidoku" and m.get("executable")]
graph = {
    "normal_tree": file_binding(treepath), "normal_tree_backend_exact_lines": tree_backend_lines,
    "default_metadata": file_binding(metapath),
    "root_package_id": root, "root_package_name": packages[root]["name"],
    "root_features": sorted(nodes[root]["features"]),
    "metadata_package_count": len(packages), "metadata_resolve_node_count": len(nodes),
    "metadata_root_reachable_count": len(reachable),
    "metadata_count_scope": "Cargo default metadata resolved closure, including dev and target-specific dependencies; not a count of host-active compiled packages.",
    "backend_exact_package_ids": sorted(backend_ids),
    "backend_reachable_ids": sorted(backend_ids & reachable),
    "compiler_messages": file_binding(jsonlpath),
    "compiler_artifact_count": len(artifacts),
    "compiler_artifact_backend_exact_ids": artifact_backend,
    "selected_artifact_binding": file_binding(selectedpath),
    "selected_artifact_found_exactly_in_compiler_stream": len(selected_matches) == 1,
    "root_executable_artifact_count": len(root_artifacts),
    "selected_artifact": selected,
    "build_finished_messages": [m for m in messages if m.get("reason") == "build-finished"],
}
evidence_names = ["desktop-gate-manifest.json", "source-before-gate-01.json", "source-after-gate-01.json", "production-diff.json", "default-resolved-reachable-packages.json"]
report = {
    "kind": "independent-read-only-candidate8-ui-component-equivalence-observation-v1",
    "recorded_at": datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    "environment": "ssh test-env",
    "source": source, "desktop": binary, "default_build_evidence": graph,
    "evidence_bindings": [file_binding(B8 / name) for name in evidence_names],
    "executed_scope": "Read and hash existing frozen evidence, source snapshots, current source, and desktop binaries only. No Cargo, application, test, build, or performance process was launched."
}
print(json.dumps(report, indent=2, ensure_ascii=True, sort_keys=True))
